name: Rahway
notes: Section A has garbage on Monday and Thursday, Section B on Tuesday and Friday, every week of the year. Put garbage out the night before.

Garbage containers must be under 44 gallons and 50 lb, with solid handles, no wheels and a lid (or drainage holes), in good condition. Material in improper containers is not collected. Mattresses must be bagged.

Recycling is every other Wednesday (Sections A and B on alternate weeks). Paper products (books, magazines, junk mail, cardboard, newspaper) go in one container; bottles, cans and plastic containers in a separate one. Recycling mixed with garbage is not collected.
Bulky waste (furniture, lumber, carpeting) goes out on your second garbage day of the week: Thursday in Section A, Friday in Section B.

Yard waste is picked up April 6 to November 3, 2026, on your first garbage day of the week (Monday in A, Tuesday in B), separate from garbage: reusable containers of 44 gallons or less or paper bags, under 50 lb, never plastic bags. Tie branches in bundles 4 feet long.

Leaves are collected November 4 to December 31, 2026, while crews are in your area (leaf hotline 732-827-2063). Do not put leaf piles in the road before November 2, and keep branches out of them. Free leaf bags at the DPW with a valid ID.

On the 7 holidays (New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, July 3, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) there is no garbage, bulky or yard waste pickup that day; it waits for your next regular day.

Electronics, white goods (appliances) and scrap metal are picked up by appointment: call the DPW at 732-827-2159, also for missed collections. Household special waste: Union County, 908-654-9889. Used motor oil: Main Street Fire Department, Saturdays 8:30 AM-4:30 PM.
sources: Garbage & Recycling Division and its pages (recycling, bulky waste, yard waste, white goods, motor oil): https://www.cityofrahway.org/213/Garbage-Recycling-Division ; the web page says yard waste starts April 1, the mailer April 6 (mailer used)
